scope: Four high-level observables in dileptonic ttbar: improve resolution and migration while preserving distribution agreement

paper.qualification: Published rounded test values are contextual reference values, not a paired statistical baseline for our validation predictions.

primary_target.resolution: q(0.8413, prediction - truth) - q(0.1587, prediction - truth); full width; lower is better
primary_target.trace: Mean diagonal of a truth-row-normalized response matrix; higher is better; exact paper bins and flow treatment must be verified
primary_target.ambition: Improve both metrics on each of the four observables against a verified paper-compatible VyPER baseline
primary_target.same_output_requirement: The output rule used to claim better resolution/trace must also be evaluated for shape; metrics from different prediction rules cannot be combined into one simultaneous-improvement claim.

distribution_checks.idealized_reconstruction: Paper Fig. 5 uses a different reference: true assignments and neutrinos with reconstructed visible objects. Evaluate separately when this reference is available.
distribution_checks.tolerance_policy: Choose and document physically meaningful tolerances using training/validation information before evaluating the held-out test set; do not pick tolerances after seeing test results.

prediction_rules.deterministic: One observable vector per event; report all metrics on this vector
prediction_rules.generative_single_draw: One reproducibly seeded draw per event; report resolution, trace, and shape on these same predictions; repeat inference seeds to quantify sampling variability
prediction_rules.generative_multi_draw: Derive observables for each draw first, then report per-observable means and medians separately with their own resolution, trace, and shape; compare VyPER using the same sample count and summary rule
prediction_rules.full_posterior_shape: If pooling samples, each event has total weight one; label this separately from point-estimate shape
prediction_rules.paper_samples_per_event: Not yet established; 200 diffusion steps is not a count of independent samples.

requirements: Verify row alignment and field order
Keep the test set out of model and hyperparameter selection

comparison_status.existing_predictions: Validation, single training seed, heterogeneous training and checkpoint selection; suitable for screening
comparison_status.existing_vyper: Release configuration, epoch 97, one draw/event, not an exact paper reproduction
comparison_status.paper_analysis_repository: https://github.com/els285/VyPERpaper returned 404; unavailable for implementation verification

next_experiment.status: design_only; no new Slurm jobs submitted
next_experiment.purpose: Test whether a conditional residual distribution repairs shape compression around an accurate point predictor
next_experiment.common_base: A verified existing full-data deterministic checkpoint; freeze the encoder and point head for the initial density-head comparison
controls: Identical frozen base and conditioning features
No target or truth-region input at inference
Identical inference sample counts and summary rules
Respect bounded angular support without post-hoc clipping
Predeclare checkpoint selection using validation metrics
next_experiment.cost_accounting: Count frozen-base training, feature caching, head fitting, and inference separately; do not describe head-only cost as total method cost
next_experiment.later_stage: Validate the best candidate with adequate training and at least three training seeds before a frozen test comparison; report paired event uncertainty and training-seed variability separately
next_experiment.agent_route: Retain as an optional later ablation; current mass-loss gate is not the main proposed improvement.

claim_policy: Scope any improvement to these four ttbar observables and the evaluated output rule. Do not generalize to assignment, neutrino reconstruction, all physics channels, or a fully reproduced paper unless separately demonstrated.
